name: Sheets
description: A collection of all the sheets in the specified or active workbook.
remarks: The Sheets collection can contain Chart or Worksheet objects. The Sheets collection is useful when you want to return sheets of any type. If you need to work with sheets of only one type, see the object topic for that sheet type.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: HPageBreaks
properties.description: Returns an HPageBreaks collection that represents the horizontal page breaks on the sheet. Read-only.

properties.name: VPageBreaks
properties.description: Returns a VPageBreaks collection that represents the vertical page breaks on the sheet. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that determines whether the object is visible.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([Before As Variant], [After As Variant], [Count As Variant], [Type As Variant]) As Object
methods.description: Creates a new worksheet, chart, or macro sheet. The new worksheet becomes the active sheet.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: An object that specifies the sheet before which the new sheet is added.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: An object that specifies the sheet after which the new sheet is added.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of sheets to be added. The default value is the number of selected sheets.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the sheet type. Can be one of the following XlSheetType constants: xlWorksheet, xlChart, xlExcel4MacroSheet, or xlExcel4IntlMacroSheet. If you are inserting a sheet based on an existing template, specify the path to the template. The default value is xlWorksheet.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the sheet to another location in the workbook.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: The sheet before which the copied sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _Before_ if you specify _After_.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The sheet after which the copied sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _After_ if you specify _Before_.

methods.name: FillAcrossSheets
methods.description: Copies a range to the same area on all other worksheets in a collection.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range to fill on all the worksheets in the collection. The range must be from a worksheet within the collection.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies how to copy the range.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves the sheet to another location in the workbook.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: The sheet before which the moved sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _Before_ if you specify _After_.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The sheet after which the moved sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _After_ if you specify _Before_.

methods.name: PrintPreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of the object as it would look when printed.

parameters.name: EnableChanges
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to specify if the user can change the margins and other page setup options available in print preview.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: Used only with sheets. True to replace the current selection with the specified object. False to extend the current selection to include any previously selected objects and the specified object.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([From As Variant], [To As Variant], [Copies As Variant], [Preview As Variant], [ActivePrinter As Variant], [PrintToFile As Variant], [Collate As Variant], [PrToFileName As Variant], [IgnorePrintAreas As Variant])

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start printing. If this argument is omitted, printing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to print. If this argument is omitted, printing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to print. If this argument is omitted, one copy is printed.

parameters.name: Preview
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel invoke print preview before printing the object. False (or omitted) to print the object immediately.

parameters.name: ActivePrinter
parameters.description: Sets the name of the active printer.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: True to print to a file. If _PrToFileName_ is not specified, Excel prompts the user to enter the name of the output file.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: True to collate multiple copies.

parameters.name: PrToFileName
parameters.description: If _PrintToFile_ is set to True, this argument specifies the name of the file that you want to print to.

parameters.name: IgnorePrintAreas
parameters.description: True to ignore print areas and print the entire object.

methods.name: Add2
methods.signature: Add2([Before As Variant], [After As Variant], [Count As Variant], [NewLayout As Variant]) As Object
methods.description: This method is only implemented for the Charts collection object and will produce a run-time error if used on the Sheets and Worksheets objects.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: An object that specifies the sheet before which the new sheet is added.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: An object that specifies the sheet after which the new sheet is added.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of sheets to be added. The default value is one.

parameters.name: NewLayout
parameters.description: The layout of the new worksheet.
